notes.title: Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon and other JAST visual novels on sale!
notes.content:
Steam Spring Sale is finally here!

The blossoming cherry petals bring with it another season of flowers and sunshine. And this spring, JAST has an even better offer for you to make sure you enjoy this spring to its full extent. And this offer would be for a limited time only so don't waste any time and get your hands on a copy right now! 💮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43864321/55ee0f30a6d5c40d867f0c2c9406c453d2c4ceef.png

This Sale brings you Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon at 30% off! This is an irresistible discount specially made for all our fans who have shown us love and support till now, so please go ahead and enjoy this offer while it lasts.
And don't forget to visit our website because this season we're hosting more discounts for our other titles too!

Get Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon at a discount of 30% off!

And as always stay tuned to our socials to keep yourself updated with the latest news from JAST games and join our Discord server for exclusive events and rewards.

Thank you for the support,
And have a fun time!
